short_description: Evolutionary ecology research for continuous environment-driven plant specialization, species catalogs, population truth and representation-safe future runtime integration.
purpose: Prove that vegetation diversity can emerge from environmental fields, resource trade-offs, mutation, competition, dispersal and history without hardcoded biome placement or duplicate world foundations.
expected_outcome: A deterministic plant ecology research model, accepted experiment evidence and portable SpeciesCatalog design that can later converge into canonical runtime through a fresh PC0/harness-controlled branch.
current_stage: ECO.R0 Program Definition / Vegetation Experiment Design
progress_note: Research program, P0 alignment, machine-readable roadmap and vegetation experiment ladder are documented. No production runtime ownership is claimed and no canonical world state is changed.
next_stage: ECO.P1 Plant Adaptation Proof: implement EXP-V0 Environmental Field Determinism, EXP-V1 Single Species Resource Response, EXP-V2 Mutation and Local Adaptation, and EXP-V3 Competition of Strategies on a deterministic synthetic fixture; stop for evidence review before succession/speciation work.
dependencies: G environment semantics as future production input
Matter/Material Ontology as future substrate truth
Harness gate before production runtime promotion

ownership_claims.scope: research-only ecology traits, population models, evolution experiments and SpeciesCatalog candidate contracts
